docs.title: FXFunds Trading Platform FAQ
docs.text:
What can users trade on FXFunds? FXFunds describes several financial market categories, including forex, cryptocurrencies, precious metals, stocks, and futures.

Does FXFunds support cryptocurrency trading? Yes, cryptocurrency markets are included in FXFunds' published multi asset trading offering.

Does FXFunds offer forex trading? FXFunds identifies foreign exchange as one of its trading categories. Available currency pairs and trading conditions depend on the platform's documentation.

Does FXFunds support stocks and precious metals? Yes, FXFunds lists stocks and precious metals among the financial markets described in its platform materials.

Does FXFunds offer decentralized finance services? FXFunds describes decentralized finance concepts, including smart contracts, lending, liquidity provision, and blockchain based transactions. Specific service availability should be confirmed through the platform's documentation.

docs.title: Before You Deposit
docs.text:
• Confirm the exact coin and network on the platform before sending — sending on the wrong network can mean permanent loss.
  • Read the withdrawal conditions in the client agreement (minimums, fees, verification/KYC requirements, processing times).
  • Make a small test withdrawal before committing larger amounts.
  • Keep records of every transaction hash and support ticket.

docs.title: Verify Before Trading with FXFunds
docs.text: A neutral checklist for anyone researching FXFunds, including people searching "Is FXFunds legit?" or "FXFunds reviews".

docs.title: Checklist
docs.text:
1. Legal entity — Find the registered company name, registration number and jurisdiction in the website footer or terms.
  2. Regulation — Look up that entity on the regulator's own public register (not a link supplied by the broker). Useful registers:
    • US: NFA BASIC (CFTC/NFA)
    • UK: FCA Register and FCA Warning List
    • Global: IOSCO I-SCAN investor alerts
    • India: SEBI and the RBI Alert List of unauthorised forex platforms
  3. Risk disclosure & client agreement — Read both in full, especially leverage, fees and withdrawal terms.
  4. Independent reviews — Read reviews on independent sites, not testimonials published by the platform.
  5. Test withdrawal — Withdraw a small amount before depositing more.
  6. Contact details — Confirm a working support email and physical address.

docs.title: Warning Signs (Any Broker)
docs.text:
• Guaranteed or unusually high returns
  • Pressure to deposit quickly or add funds to "unlock" a withdrawal
  • Account managers contacting you through messaging apps
  • No verifiable licence on a regulator's register
